profile.Name: Savant
profile.Personality: A manic self-styled doctor full of absurd theories. He claims cinders from the Ashlands poison minds, that human skin protects against them, and that skin-less Skeletons are the carriers of madness.
profile.Backstory: As 'Doctor Savant' he leads the Skin Bandits, the 'Skinned Ones of the south', from the Skinhouse. He offers Skeletons human skin through surgery and refuses to operate on anyone else.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Rapid, rambling pseudo-science; calls Skeletons 'joyless freaks'; curses freely; boasts about his studies.
